Adani Group and UAE's IHC to invest in Odisha aluminium project

Adani Enterprises and the UAE's International Holding Company (IHC) have announced plans for a significant aluminium project in Odisha. The proposed investment is estimated to be around ₹1.08 lakh crore (approximately $11.5 billion) and will be developed in phases. The project aims to establish a 2 million tonnes per annum plant and could help India reduce its reliance on imported aluminium.
